title: Fractions and their represented sections have the same equality
statement: Let k be a field, S=k[x0,x1] with its standard grading [def-sc-p1-standard], P=Proj S, G an O_P-module and M a Z-graded S-module with additive pieces M_z and S_n M_z contained in M_(n+z). Let phi_z be additive equivalences M_z -> Gamma(P,G tensor O_P(z)) for z>=0, compatible with homogeneous multiplication [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf]. For f in S_d, define Rel(x,s) to mean that some m>=0 and y in M_(m*d) satisfy x=y/f^m in M_f and that phi_(m*d)(y) restricts to multiplication of s by f^m on D+(f). Assume d>0, G coherent [pqf-def-coherent], M internally graded and M_z=0 for z<0. For all x,z in M_f and s,t in Gamma(D+(f),G), Rel(x,s) and Rel(z,t) imply (x=z iff s=t).

source.place: Proposition 0BXD, final paragraph; parent chart proof step 1

proof.text:
Take witnesses y/f^m and z/f^n for the relations. Equality of fractions
means some f^e kills f^n*y-f^m*z. Apply phi in degree (m+n+e)*d.
Compatibility with homogeneous multiplication and restriction identifies the
result with multiplication by f^(m+n+e) on s-t, which is invertible on D+(f),
so s=t. Conversely, if s=t then the restrictions of phi(f^n*y-f^m*z)
vanish. The annihilation clause of serreSectionModuleComparison supplies a
power f^e killing its image under phi. Compatibility and injectivity of phi
kill f^e*(f^n*y-f^m*z), and LocalizedModule.mk_eq gives equal fractions.
The empty open and zero localization when f=0 satisfy both directions.
